temporary_binary_namespace.reason: Runtime binary, datadir, config-file, and artifact-name migration is intentionally deferred to a separate release step.

production_blockers.description: Choose and publish ZKCOIN_RELEASE_VERSION, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_TAG, and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SOURCE_COMMIT so source tagging, Gitian inputs, release notes, and GitHub release metadata all reference the same release source.

Publish and independently verify ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_FINGERPRINT, the authorized local ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_ID, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_CUSTODY_RECORD, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_CUSTODY_OWNER, and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_REVOCATION_PLAN.
Choose and publish ZKCOIN_GITIAN_SIGS_REPO_URL, ZKCOIN_GITIAN_SIGNER_QUORUM, ZKCOIN_GITIAN_AUTHORIZED_SIGNERS_FILE, and authorized signer fingerprints for the zkCoin Gitian signer quorum.

Choose and publish ZKCOIN_DETACHED_SIGS_REPO_URL, ZKCOIN_DETACHED_SIGS_RELEASE_REF, ZKCOIN_DETACHED_SIGS_RELEASE_TAG, ZKCOIN_DETACHED_SIGS_CUSTODY_RECORD, ZKCOIN_DETACHED_SIGS_CUSTODY_OWNER, and ZKCOIN_DETACHED_SIGS_PAYLOAD_APPROVAL for Windows and macOS signing payloads.

Choose and publish ZKCOIN_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_BASE_URL, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_CHECKSUMS_URL, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_WEBSITE_REPO_URL, and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_INDEX_REPO_URL for release artifacts and metadata, then fetch and verify the public checksum URL before announcing.
Choose and publish ZKCOIN_RELEASE_ANNOUNCEMENT_CHANNELS and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_ANNOUNCEMENT_OWNER for release announcements.

Choose and publish ZKCOIN_RELEASE_NOTES_PATH, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_NOTES_BRANCH, and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_NOTES_OWNER, then verify matching archived notes exist on master and the release branch before creating the GitHub release.
Choose and publish ZKCOIN_RELEASE_GITHUB_TAG, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_GITHUB_TITLE, and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_GITHUB_OWNER before creating the GitHub release.
Decide and publish ZKCOIN_RELEASE_BINARY_NAMESPACE before signing; the current tree only allows litecoin-compatibility until binary/artifact migration is completed.

Choose and publish ZKCOIN_MACOS_BUNDLE_ID, ZKCOIN_MACOS_CODESIGN_IDENTITY, ZKCOIN_MACOS_CODESIGN_CERT_CUSTODY, ZKCOIN_MACOS_CODESIGN_CERT_OWNER, ZKCOIN_MACOS_CODESIGN_PAYLOAD_APPROVAL, ZKCOIN_MACOS_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD_SOURCE, ZKCOIN_MACOS_NOTARIZATION_REQUEST_UUID, and notarization ownership.

Choose and publish ZKCOIN_WINDOWS_CODESIGN_KEY_PATH, ZKCOIN_WINDOWS_CODESIGN_KEY_CUSTODY, ZKCOIN_WINDOWS_CODESIGN_KEY_OWNER, ZKCOIN_WINDOWS_CODESIGN_PAYLOAD_APPROVAL, and the authorized Windows code-signing key workflow.

current_inherited_release_surfaces.reason: Source archive names still use the temporary Litecoin compatibility namespace.
Automated Gitian helper is inherited from Bitcoin Core and must not be used for zkCoin releases.
Legacy Bitcoin Core verification helper remains guarded for upstream-reference use only; zkCoin verification uses verify-zkcoin-release.py.
Autotools tarname intentionally remains litecoin until binary/artifact migration is decided.
MSVC tarname intentionally remains litecoin until binary/artifact migration is decided.

notes: Do not treat Gitian, signing, notarization, upload, or binary verification instructions as production zkCoin release instructions while status is release_infrastructure_not_ready.

Release source provenance docs require ZKCOIN_RELEASE_VERSION, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_TAG, and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SOURCE_COMMIT before Gitian builds, verify the signed tag, and require Gitian checkout, release notes, and GitHub release metadata to use the same tag and version.
The source release-candidate validation gate proves source tarball real-proof readiness only; it is not binary release readiness and does not authorize publishing artifacts.
Gitian source descriptors fetch zk-coin/zkcoin while retaining the litecoin input directory name until binary and artifact namespace migration is decided.
Release checksum docs require ZKCOIN_RELEASE_BINARY_NAMESPACE before writing SHA256SUMS and reject zkcoin until binary and artifact namespace migration is completed.

Release checksum docs require ZKCOIN_GITIAN_SIGNER_QUORUM and ZKCOIN_GITIAN_AUTHORIZED_SIGNERS_FILE, reject unauthorized Gitian signer directories, and count only authorized signer identities with published fingerprints before creating SHA256SUMS.asc so inherited fixed quorum assumptions cannot authorize zkCoin artifacts.
zkCoin binary artifact verification is parameterized through contrib/verifybinaries/verify-zkcoin-release.py; production signing keys and artifact hosts remain separate release blockers.

Gitian signer descriptors intentionally use an example.invalid detached-signatures URL and release docs require ZKCOIN_DETACHED_SIGS_REPO_URL, ZKCOIN_DETACHED_SIGS_RELEASE_REF, ZKCOIN_DETACHED_SIGS_RELEASE_TAG, ZKCOIN_DETACHED_SIGS_CUSTODY_RECORD, ZKCOIN_DETACHED_SIGS_CUSTODY_OWNER, and ZKCOIN_DETACHED_SIGS_PAYLOAD_APPROVAL so inherited Litecoin detached signatures, ambiguous release refs, or undocumented signing-payload custody cannot be used by default.

Release checksum signing docs require ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_FINGERPRINT, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_ID, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_CUSTODY_RECORD, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_CUSTODY_OWNER, and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_REVOCATION_PLAN before creating SHA256SUMS.asc so a default local GPG key or undocumented custody path cannot sign zkCoin releases by accident.
Release checksum docs enumerate ZKCOIN_RELEASE_ARTIFACTS and compare the release directory to the expected non-debug artifact set before writing SHA256SUMS.
Release docs require a local pre-upload verify-zkcoin-release.py check of SHA256SUMS.asc and the artifact directory before resolving publication targets.

Release artifact publication docs require ZKCOIN_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_BASE_URL, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_CHECKSUMS_URL, and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_GITHUB_REPO_URL so inherited Litecoin and Bitcoin publication targets cannot be used by default, and the public post-upload verification fetches ZKCOIN_RELEASE_CHECKSUMS_URL into ZKCOIN_PUBLIC_VERIFY_DIR before running verify-zkcoin-release.py.

Release metadata publication docs require ZKCOIN_RELEASE_WEBSITE_REPO_URL, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_WEBSITE_OWNER, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_INDEX_REPO_URL, and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_INDEX_OWNER before updating public zkCoin release indexes or websites.
Release announcement docs require ZKCOIN_RELEASE_ANNOUNCEMENT_CHANNELS and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_ANNOUNCEMENT_OWNER before announcing a zkCoin release.

Release notes archival docs require ZKCOIN_RELEASE_NOTES_PATH, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_NOTES_BRANCH, and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_NOTES_OWNER, require the path to match doc/release-notes/release-notes-${VERSION}.md, and verify matching archived notes with git cat-file -e and git diff --quiet before creating the zkCoin GitHub release.
GitHub release docs require ZKCOIN_RELEASE_GITHUB_TAG, ZKCOIN_RELEASE_GITHUB_TITLE, and ZKCOIN_RELEASE_GITHUB_OWNER before creating a zkCoin GitHub release.

macOS notarization docs require ZKCOIN_MACOS_BUNDLE_ID, zkCoin Apple notarization variables, ZKCOIN_MACOS_CODESIGN_IDENTITY, ZKCOIN_MACOS_CODESIGN_CERT_CUSTODY, ZKCOIN_MACOS_CODESIGN_CERT_OWNER, ZKCOIN_MACOS_CODESIGN_PAYLOAD_APPROVAL, ZKCOIN_MACOS_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD_SOURCE, and ZKCOIN_MACOS_NOTARIZATION_REQUEST_UUID so inherited Litecoin bundle identifiers, placeholder notarization secrets, or undocumented macOS signing certificate custody cannot be used by default.

Windows signing docs require ZKCOIN_WINDOWS_CODESIGN_KEY_PATH, ZKCOIN_WINDOWS_CODESIGN_KEY_CUSTODY, ZKCOIN_WINDOWS_CODESIGN_KEY_OWNER, and ZKCOIN_WINDOWS_CODESIGN_PAYLOAD_APPROVAL so placeholder signing key paths or undocumented Windows signing payload custody cannot be used by default.
When a blocker is resolved, update this manifest and the release lint in the same PR.
